name: Website Form Submission to Google Sheets
description: Receive a website form submission by webhook, normalize the submitted fields, append the data into a Google Sheet, notify the operator, and write an audit log.

nodes.name: Webhook Received
nodes.notes: Website form posts JSON data to this workflow webhook endpoint.

integrationSettings.sampleEvent: {"name":"Jane Customer","email":"jane@example.com","phone":"626-555-0100","company":"Demo Company","message":"I need help automating my business workflow.","source_page":"https://www.cellaidata.com/contact","submitted_at":"2026-09-06T10:00:00Z"}

nodes.name: Normalize Form Fields
nodes.notes: Convert any website form payload into clean spreadsheet columns.

nodes.name: Google Sheets Append Row
nodes.notes: Append normalized form submission rows into a Google Sheet. Configure Spreadsheet ID, Sheet tab, and field mapping.

integrationSettings.fieldMapping:
Submitted At <- submitted_at
Name <- name
Email <- email
Phone <- phone
Company <- company
Message <- message
Source Page <- source_page
UTM Source <- utm_source
UTM Campaign <- utm_campaign
Status <- status

nodes.name: Gmail Notify Operator
nodes.notes: Send an internal notification when a new form submission is captured.

nodes.name: Write Form Submission Log
nodes.notes: Audit webhook receipt, sheet append status, and notification status.
